top_signals.title: CNBC Daily Open: Trump's deal seems to be in dire straits
top_signals.summary: Trump had said a deal with Tehran could come by Thursday stateside. But if one does not arrive by noon today in Asia, that timeline will have slipped.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
